summary: Owned-set rollouts retain their admission refusal for harness-family changes, with an additional reconciliation guard against carrying a native session across providers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire changes. Cross-provider owned-set rollouts remain unsupported and are rejected before draining. Same-provider native-session and login-account continuity checks are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No change to rollout admission or the existing drain and fenced-stop sequence.

recovery.detail: Reconciliation refuses cross-provider native-session injection or verification if an admission guard is relaxed in the future.
